points.label: Travel after calling
points.left: A light, a voice, and Ananias meet Saul. But Saul, still breathing threats and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went to the high priest Immediately something like scales fell from his eyes, and he received his sight. He arose and was baptized.
points.right: Revelation, former zeal, calling, and Arabia. But I make known to you, brothers, about the Good News which was preached by me, that it is not according to man. nor did I go up to Jerusalem to those who were apostles before me, but I went away into Arabia. Then I returned to Damascus.
